input: Find nature, outdoor adventure, farm, horseback riding and fishing summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Brevard, Pisgah Forest, Rosman, Cedar Mountain, Lake Toxaway and Sapphire, NC (Transylvania County). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
